comment: mkmaze.c setup_waterlevel() and mk_bubble(): mk_bubble() appends each bubble to svb.bbubbles, which only unsetup_waterlevel() empties. #wizloaddes (wizcmds.c wiz_load_splua()) on the Plane of Water runs fixup_special() twice, once at the end of load_special() and again in lspo_finalize_level(), so setup_waterlevel() makes a second set of bubbles beside the first, and movebubbles() moves both sets each turn. A dwarvish Valkyrie in debug mode level-teleports with ^V to the Plane of Water (the menu's 'K' entry), wishes for nothing, runs #wizloaddes minefill and searches for five turns. Seed, date, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
